in_marathi.name: Grahurvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ancestor of planets
in_marathi.long_meaning: Grahurvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words: 'Grah' meaning planet and 'Rvansh' meaning ancestry. This name is considered to represent someone who is the ancestor or ruler of planets. In Hindu mythology, the gods are believed to rule over various planets and Grahurvansh could be a name given to a child born under the influence of these planets.
